_comment: Packages whose licence ships as a LICENSE file inside the package (nuget-license reports type File, which it cannot map). Verified by reading the file; keep the version pinned so a licence change on a bump is re-checked.

Native SNI runtime that Microsoft.Data.SqlClient pulls in on Windows. Its LICENSE.txt is the proprietary MICROSOFT SOFTWARE LICENSE TERMS (redistribution permitted with the SqlClient library), not an SPDX licence, so nuget-license cannot map it. Verified by reading the file; pinned so a bump re-checks it.
